decisions.reason: As the publicly announced flagship closely tied to the firm's direction, high sunk costs and visible commitment make management persist with it despite any lack of evidence of success.
Invested in a full product line close to the core lighting offer, management treats any disappointing results as temporary and continues the product to justify the earlier launch.
Because the home automation server box builds on the firm's established home automation offering and has incurred development and launch investments, escalation of commitment predicts keeping it.
Similar to B, the luminaire family is close to the established offer and represents substantial investment, so management will likely continue it.
